# mapbox generate-skills

1 command. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox generate-skills

Write Agent Skills describing this CLI's own commands, for a coding agent to read

Write Agent Skills describing this CLI's own commands.

Produces a `mapbox-cli` skill directory — a SKILL.md index, an AGENTS.md carrying the same prose, and one reference page per command group listing every command with its arguments, the request it makes and a worked example.

The content is derived from the command tree this binary built, not from the API specs, so it describes exactly the commands that exist: an operation this CLI withholds, disables or treats as a liveness probe is absent from the skill for the same reason it is absent from `--help`.

Two runs of one binary write byte-identical files, so the result can be committed and a diff means the CLI changed. Nothing here reaches the network, and no token is needed.

With no flags, writes into the project directory of every agent whose home directory is present — so a run usually writes several places, all of them named in the output.

`mapbox agent-skills uninstall mapbox-cli` removes every copy again. Reach for that rather than deleting the directories by hand: it knows all of the places this command writes to, and a sandboxed agent is often allowed to run it when it is not allowed to remove files.

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent` | `--agent AGENT` | no | string | `claude-code`, `codex`, `amp`, `cline`, `continue`, `cursor` (+9 more) | Agent to write skills for, repeatable. Defaults to whichever agents are installed. |
| `dir` | `--dir DIR` | no | string |  | Write to this directory instead, and nowhere else. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | List the files this would write, then exit without writing them. |
| `force` | `--force` | no | boolean |  | Replace a skill directory holding files this command did not write. |
| `global` | `--global` | no | boolean |  | Write to the agent's home directory, for every project, rather than this one. |
| `service` | `--service SERVICE` | no | string |  | Describe only this command group, repeatable. Defaults to all of them. |

```sh
mapbox generate-skills
```
